name: cloudflare-kv
title: 使用 Cloudflare KV 的边缘网络在全球范围内存储键值数据
description: Store key-value data globally with Cloudflare KV's edge network. Use when: caching API responses, storing configuration, managing user preferences, handling TTL expiration, or troubleshooting KV_ERROR, 429 rate limits, eventual consistency, or cacheTtl errors.
